peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 0.8% below its local comparables; 51 of 85 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Below peers (13.3): 1.5 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 32 of 266 similar developments with a figure (the same as 7). Initial resale-wave effect: 2 of the 10 resales in Oct 2024–Sep 2026 came in the first 12 months of the resale wave (Oct 2024–Jan 2025); the sustained rate is shown separately. The wave start is based on the analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date. Context, not scored: resales in 33.3% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 3-bedroom: median $1,590,000 ($1,704 psf, 904–1,496 sq ft; 6 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,717 psf (range $1,507–1,775); 0.8% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $12,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: 1.5 resales per 100 homes a year over 20 months (Feb 2025–Sep 2026): higher than 31 of 258 similar developments. First resale wave from Feb 2024 (analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date); 6 earlier resales do not start the wave. Observed 24-month activity: 1.5.

wave.basisLabel: analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Hume MRT about 150 m, Hillview MRT about 940 m; closer than 441 of 462 similar developments (the same as 1). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 0 within 1 km and 6 within 2 km; nearest CHIJ Our Lady Queen of Peace about 1,440 m; more than 0 of 462 similar developments (the same as 58). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

nearest.name: CHIJ Our Lady Queen of Peace

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 1 supermarket within 1 km (nearest about 720 m), more than 18 of 462 similar developments (the same as 37); nearest hawker centre Bukit Timah Interim Hawker Centre And Market about 1,640 m; nearest park Bukit Batok Nature Park about 200 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Bukit Timah Interim Hawker Centre And Market

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 6 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (The Sen, 177 new sales, about 750 m; Hillhaven, 13 new sales, about 1,060 m; The Botany at Dairy Farm, 2 new sales, about 1,520 m; 8@BT, 34 new sales, about 1,690 m; Narra Residences, 214 new sales, about 1,760 m; The Reserve Residences, 2 new sales, about 1,850 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 91 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 442 new sales and 598 resales (1,040 purchases); new sales were 42.5% of these purchases. Subsales (39) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 598 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 178 of 462 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 598 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 582 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (+2.7%). Planning-area private resales −2.8%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
